title: PREVIEW source-specific observed endpoint reproduction and missing-outcome completion specification
status: frozen used-source numerical reproduction specification; not preregistration or independent validation
source_family: PREVIEW adult trial; original protocol2017, primary report2021, secondary endpoint analysis2025/2026

access.secondary_article_and_esm: CC BY4.0, subject to separately credited third-party material
access.participant_records: corresponding-author reasonable request; not unrestricted public

scope.population: Main secondary-analysis selected phase2 cohort: baseline source-defined prediabetes, overweight/obesity, successful common initial weight-loss phase, then received assigned maintenance intervention.
scope.randomization: Baseline four-arm2x2 diet-by-activity assignment, stratified by center/sex/age; allocation concealed until week8 maintenance start.
scope.selection: The responder cohort is selected after baseline assignment during a common run-in with concealed maintenance allocation. Conditional randomized inference could be justified if identical run-in, concealment, and assignment-independent selection hold. Observed-endpoint contrasts additionally require missingness assumptions for causal interpretation; no full-recruit or national effect is claimed.
scope.exposure: Assigned bundled moderate-protein/moderate-GI versus high-protein/low-GI maintenance regimens; both activity assignments pooled within each diet.
scope.time_origin: Nominal study baseline; week52/year1 and week156/year3 include the common initial8weeks. Baseline visit and randomization dates are distinct: original2021 section3 records withdrawals between them. Actual participant dates/windows are unavailable in the aggregate cells.
scope.baseline_vs_phase2: Normalization can occur during common run-in. These endpoints do not isolate new phase2 reversals or prove sustained normality.
scope.endpoint: Source point-in-time normal fasting plasma glucose AND normal2-hour OGTT glucose at the specified assessment.

source_thresholds.role: source endpoint definition only; not engine state mapping

scope.diagnosis_history: PriorT2D excluded at screening; persistent diagnosis/type and treatment-free remission history are not reconstructed from endpoint counts.
scope.medication_rule: Baseline outcome-affecting medication exclusion and concomitant-medication collection are documented; no verified medication-free duration or confirmation rule for this secondary normalization endpoint.
scope.eligibility_wording_conflict: Secondary main population criteria use elevated fasting and/or OGTT glucose; its Outcomes paragraph uses and. Retain source wording; no invented reconciliation or baseline engine allocation.
scope.run_in_wording_conflict: Original2017 protocol describes >8% loss for maintenance entry; later reports describe >=8%. Preserve literal versions; no silent harmonization.

allowed_literal_main_cells.locator: Secondary main Methods/Outcomes/Statisticalanalysis; Results/Participants and Prediabetesremission; Figure1a caption. Already inspected used-source cells only.
allowed_literal_main_cells.confidence_interval_level: Source-reported95%; retain as published adjusted-model uncertainty, not a count-derived confidence interval.
allowed_literal_main_cells.additional_result_cells: Not authorized for the first numerical reproduction; retain previously viewed auxiliary results as used-source context only.

denominator_reconciliation: Verify literal y,n,N against pinned main source and exact locator, including arm and assessment labels; require integer0<=y<=n<=N.
Keep selected-phase2 N distinct from all-baseline randomized N, visit attendance/completers, complete-case sensitivity population and available endpoint n.
m=N-n denotes endpoint-unclassified people for the specified arm/time; it is not the paper dropout count and must not be presented as death/loss count.
Do not force endpoint n to equal attendance/completer counts. Preserve unexplained missing-test/analysis-selection reasons as unresolved.
Already inspected ESMp8 Table1 arm header/body denominators are inconsistent with main selected-arm N. Preserve conflict; no guessed typo correction or overwrite of main cells.
Original2021 report and secondaryESM auxiliary diabetes-incidence results differ in reported totals/analyses. Keep separate source vintages and estimands; never pool.

outputs_after_freeze.available_endpoint_proportion: p_obs[a,t]=y[a,t]/n[a,t], descriptive within the source endpoint analysis denominator.
outputs_after_freeze.available_endpoint_absolute_contrast: delta_obs[t]=p_obs[MP_MGI,t]-p_obs[HP_LGI,t]; units proportion points, optionally displayed as percentage points with explicit conversion.
outputs_after_freeze.published_adjusted_effect: Retain reported adjustedRR andCI separately. Do not equate it with the raw proportion ratio or reproduce the fitted Poisson model from marginal counts.

bounds_definition.target: Binary endpoint completion for the original main selected-phase2 cohort; explicitly distinct from normality among survivors or clinical physiological recovery.
bounds_definition.observed_positive: Retain the published source normalization classification when the endpoint is available; do not infer physiological state or erase diagnosis.
bounds_definition.observed_negative: Retain the available source binary endpoint noncase classification; missing tests are never negatives.
bounds_definition.death: Only a verified death before source assessment may be fixed as0 for an explicitly named alive-and-normal composite. It is not a normoglycemia state. No source death count/status is supplied by these main cells; remain unknown, never assume no deaths.
bounds_definition.unknown: Unclassified endpoint, unknown survival, unknown treatment history and absent test status stay unresolved. The mathematical completion envelope allows unclassified binary values0or1; this is sensitivity analysis, not observed outcomes or survival/remission probability.
bounds_definition.conditions: Compute selected-cohort completion bounds only after N/y/n reconciliation. If a literal clinical alive-and-normal composite cannot be tied to source assessment/death rules, publish the mathematical envelope with clinical-composite interpretation unavailable.
bounds_definition.meaning: Deterministic extreme missing-outcome completions; not confidence or credible intervals. Do not use the upper completion to imply death absence.

outputs_after_freeze.uncertainty: Preserve published adjustedRR uncertainty and deterministic missing-endpoint bounds. No new samplingCI, clustering adjustment, imputation or probabilistic sensitivity model in first reproduction.

null_and_opposing_results: Retain the original primary first-diabetes endpoint report of no statistically significant dietary difference; this does not establish a zero effect. The selected normal-glucose endpoint favors the moderate-protein/moderate-GI bundle. Neither is a generic Food is Health or UPF effect; no primary incidence coefficient extraction in this unit.
identification_limits: Missing-outcome status is not identified from randomization. No defaultMAR, missing-at-random imputation, last-observation-carried-forward or missing=noncase.

Conditional selected/assessed-arm contrast is not full randomized intention-to-treat dietary causal effect. Any stronger causal statement requires explicit selection, adherence, missingness and treatment assumptions.
Marginal endpoint counts do not identify individual transitions, number/direction of intervening changes, onset/recovery dates, annual transition intensities or remission persistence.
No joint-year overlaps/covariance supplied. Analyze each time separately; no product of year likelihoods, independent repeated-event treatment or pooled inferential effect.
Pooled diet comparisons average over both physical-activity assignments; separate protein/GI/carbohydrate effects and dose/adherence causal effects are not isolated.
The source does not identify the active engine UPF dose coefficient or lag, physiological insulin resistance, distinct progression/recovery multipliers, mortality, costs or national transport.

failure_dispositions.hash_or_literal_cell_failure: Stop numerical reproduction; retain discrepancy with source receipt; no repair by rounded percentages.
failure_dispositions.unreconciled_endpoint_denominator: Retain literal counts and conditionally descriptive source proportion only; block selected-cohort bounds or composite interpretation as needed.
failure_dispositions.unresolved_medication_death_or_confirmat: Block clinical remission/state/competing-risk interpretation; retain source measurement endpoint.
failure_dispositions.auxiliary_source_conflict: Keep source-specific versions; no silent correction or pooling.
failure_dispositions.bounds_include_zero_or_allow_opposing_ef: Report that completion bounds do not identify direction; never tune assumptions to exclude the null.

verification_after_freeze: Frozen byte hashes and literal locators
Counts and denominators remain separate and bounded
Missing values never treated as absent diagnosis/death or negative glucose tests
Completion envelope algebra including extreme completions; no derived effect yet
No participantIDs, latent-state outputs, active registry changes or national claims
revision_policy: This v1 file remains immutable after its freeze commit. Any later analytical change requires a separately dated amendment and explicit before/after rationale.
